description: This file contains shell script functions for managing eMMC partitions, preparing filesystems, and performing firmware upgrades on a device using the uDPU platform. It includes functions for checking device availability, partition creation, formatting, mounting, and system upgrade steps.

methods.name: udpu_check_emmc
methods.description: Checks for available eMMC device, supporting multiple device names depending on hardware revision.

methods.name: udpu_part_prep
methods.description: Unmounts and prepares a partition for use, based on its mountpoint.

methods.name: udpu_do_part_check
methods.description: Validates existing partitions or creates new partitions and formats them accordingly.

methods.name: udpu_do_misc_prep
methods.description: Prepares the /misc partition for use, including mounting or reformatting if necessary.

methods.name: udpu_do_initial_setup
methods.description: Formats essential partitions (/recovery, /boot, /root) during initial setup.

methods.name: udpu_do_regular_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares and mounts partitions for firmware upgrade, cleaning previous data.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_uDPU
methods.description: Main upgrade routine that checks device, prepares the /misc partition, extracts firmware, and updates partitions.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_uDPU
methods.description: Copies configuration files from backup location to the /misc partition for persistence across upgrades.
